document_title_t: Financial Services and Markets Act 2022
docs.document_title_string_s: Financial Services and Markets Act 2022
document_shortsummary_t:
The Financial Services and Markets Act 2022 (FSMA) is an omnibus Act for the sector-wide regulation of financial services and markets.  Parliament passed the FSMA on 5 April 2022.

The FSMA will be implemented in phases.  Phase 1 of the FSMA commenced on 28 April 2023, and relates to the migration of the Anti-Money Laundering/Countering the Financing of Terrorism framework, the financial dispute resolution schemes framework, and the general powers over financial institutions from the Monetary Authority of Singapore Act 1970 ("MAS Act") to the FSMA. Phase 2A of the FSMA commenced on 10 May 2024, and relates to the implementation of new technology risk management provisions and migration of the recovery and resolution framework from the MAS Act to the FSMA. Phase 2B of the FSMA commenced on 31 July 2024, and introduces and implements MAS’ harmonised and expanded power to issue prohibition orders under Part 3 of the FSMA.
